title: The Rhythm Algorithm
logline: A shy, rusty robot overcomes its social anxiety on a vibrant neon rooftop party after an unexpected dance lesson from a sleek street dancer.
theme: Overcoming self-doubt and finding your groove.

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A shy, slightly outdated brass-plated robot with expressive blue LED eyes.

characters.name: Slick
characters.one_line_description: A charismatic, ultra-modern chrome robot with neon pink accents who loves to dance.

scenes.title: Wallflower Bolt
scenes.summary: Bolt stands nervously in the corner of a crowded, neon-lit rooftop party, clutching a oil-can drink and watching others dance.

scenes.title: The Invitation
scenes.summary: Slick notices Bolt's hesitation, glides over with a smooth spin, and extends a hand, inviting Bolt onto the dancefloor.

scenes.title: System Glitch
scenes.summary: Bolt tries to mimic Slick's wave dance move but stiffens up, emitting a squeaking sound. Slick laughs warmly and demonstrates a simpler step.

scenes.title: Finding the Groove
scenes.summary: Bolt successfully executes a classic robot dance move. His LED eyes flash green with excitement as Slick and the surrounding crowd cheer him on.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
